versions.changelog:
Initial release of Nano Banana Image Workflow Helper.

- Provides structured workflows for building and debugging AI image generation and editing tasks.
- Generates prompt packs, reference planning steps, retry rules, and visual QA checklists based on user needs.
- Includes guidance on identifying and addressing common failure points in image workflows.
- Produces ready-to-run prompts, QA checklists, retry frameworks, and deployment guides.
- Designed for designers, marketers, and workflow builders who require reliable and practical AI image solutions.
